Northside Long Beach Ride Club (Wednesday Ride)

Long Beach, CA · Northside · Social

Northside Long Beach Ride Club (Wednesday Ride) is a social group ride in Long Beach, CA. It rolls every Wednesday at 7:00 pm from Houghton Park.

For visitors

The club's Instagram page is where changes are posted. The ride ran on Tuesdays until early February 2026, so check before you go. Bring lights.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual.
Check
Look at @northsidelb_ride_club the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Northside Long Beach Ride Club (Wednesday Ride) group ride

A neighborhood ride club in North Long Beach that rolls from Houghton Park every Wednesday evening, around 10 miles at a casual pace. The club has also held a bike-in movie night at the park. The ride moved from Tuesday to Wednesday this year.
